rationale: Standalone HU aggregator listing draft laws in public consultation; native-language cross-check on the government portal.
EBA Interactive Single Rulebook is a durable, high-credibility level-1/2/3 lookup for prudential obligations and application dates.
ESMA equivalent covering markets/MiFID-MiCA files relevant to HU banks' investment services.
Big-4 HU regulatory newsletter is a useful curated digest, but URL unverified and exact feed page needs confirming.
Fast English-language HU law-firm alert aggregator but registration/paywall gates most content; human must clear access.
Regional legal-news aggregator; thin regulatory-deadline value and unverified reachability.
Commercial paywalled regtech vendor; HU coverage is a vendor claim, no free monitorable signal.
Second commercial horizon-scanning vendor; methodology marketing only, not a HU signal source.
Official NKI RSS index gives machine-readable feeds for NIS2/DORA-adjacent HU cyber obligations on financial entities.
Ministry-scoped NGM draft-legislation shelf with comment deadlines; the core A3 primary source for HU financial-sector drafts.
Cross-ministry consultation collection with standard cover sheets recording form, commenters and deadline.
Government news stream is the fastest timestamped trigger for consultation launches, linking to draft packages.
Static NGM contact/institutional page on the archived kormany.hu generation; covered by monitoring the portal, useful as reference metadata.
CDN payload layer with no listing index; fetched via kormany.hu pages rather than monitored on its own.
Jet. consolidated statute defines consultation duties and minimum comment windows; one-off reference for pipeline rules.
Implementing decree fixing publication/commenting metadata for drafts; static reference text, not a signal stream.
Government decision setting the internal egyeztetés timetable; calibrates polling frequency, one-off artifact.
Parliamentary iromány register tracks bills downstream of consultation with full texts and amendment trail.
Banking association working groups and quarterly reports reveal sector positions on drafts under consultation.
TRIS exposes HU draft technical rules (payment terminals, e-invoicing, online till) in English with standstill dates; failed check is soft.
Public-data catalogue worth mining once for ministry publication schemes; unproven for draft-legislation coverage.
Frozen cycle archives retain old draft listings and RSS indexes; needed for backfill and resolving dead links.
Legal trade press gives context on consultation practice but low signal density for concrete deadlines.
Official NGM comment mailbox is a detection marker and contact, not a fetchable feed; record once.
MNB supervisory news is the Hungarian-language first announcement point for EU/ESA developments and domestic application deadlines.
MNB executive circulars carry concrete compliance expectations and deadlines ahead of formal recommendations.
ERA reporting portal shows operational DORA submission duties and dates, but the interface likely requires credentials.
